20261103MD84850.description: Maryland Question 2. Allows temporary appointees to fill vacancies on a commission that investigates complaints about judges.
20261103MD84850.summary: This proposed amendment to Maryland's constitution would allow temporary appointees to fill vacancies on a commission that investigates complaints about judges.
20261103MD84850.seatName: 2 - Allow temporary appointments to fill Commission on Judicial Disabilities vacancies

20261103MD84882.description: Maryland Question 1. Requires the governor's budget to fund items agreed to by collective bargaining.
20261103MD84882.summary: This proposed amendment to Maryland's constitution would require the governor's budget proposal to include funding for employment items agreed to through collective bargaining.
20261103MD84882.seatName: 1 - Modify state employee collective bargaining rules

20261103MD84884.description: Maryland Question 3. Relaxes restraints on congressional redistricting.
20261103MD84884.summary: This proposed amendment to Maryland's constitution would lift restraints on congressional redistricting. It would apply requirements for compact districts that respect "natural boundaries" only to state legislative districts, not congressional districts.
20261103MD84884.seatName: 3 - Clarify that state redistricting requirements apply only to state legislative districts
